title: Environment Tech grid lists 6 features no module defines
body:
## Summary
The Environment Tech panel renders six feature names that exist in no module's feature definitions, so all six rows are permanently unknown.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/_shared/data.ts:186 declares ASSET_FEATURES, and src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/map/MapTopologyGroup.tsx:91 passes it to FeatureGrid with the arpg-world featureMap. None of the six names appears in src/lib/feature-definitions.ts. The same defect in Region Details was fixed this round by pointing at real arpg-world features, but no arpg-world feature corresponds to Level Streaming, World Partition, HLOD, Lumen, foliage or water. Fixed means either defining these features (which adds rows to the matrix and the module's stats) or removing the panel.

## Flow
- Open the world module Map tab and expand Map & Topology
- Environment Tech renders six rows from ASSET_FEATURES
- featureMap has no entry for any name, so each row reads as unknown whatever the project state

## Expected impact
Designers stop seeing six status rows that can never change. Adding definitions changes the arpg-world feature totals and NBA inputs, so it could shift other views.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - status rows reflect a tracked feature
Before: 6 of 6 names absent from src/lib/feature-definitions.ts (grep)
After: not taken; depends on the choice between defining and removing
Method: probe - grep of the definitions; the After needs a product decision, so no rung above is reachable
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/_shared/data.ts:186
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/map/MapTopologyGroup.tsx:91
grep of the 6 names in src/lib/feature-definitions.ts: 0 hits

title: Critical edge z5 to z6 hangs off a zone the critical path cannot reach
body:
## Summary
ZONE_EDGES marks Deep Core to Ruined Keep as critical, but no critical edge reaches Deep Core, so the critical path holds an orphan edge.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_world/_shared/data.ts:92 flags z5 to z6 criticalPath true, while its only feeders, z1 to z3 (data.ts:88) and z3 to z5 (data.ts:90), are false. computeCumulativePath in src/lib/world/world-model.ts filters segments by criticalPath and walks from hubs, so z5 is never reached in critical mode and the edge still draws highlighted in TopologyGraph. Fixed means the authored flags agree: either the Crystal Caves chain is critical or this edge is not, plus an invariant test that every critical edge's source is reachable along critical edges from a hub.

## Flow
- Build the critical segment list from ZONE_EDGES
- Walk from hub z1: z2, z4, z6; z5 is not visited
- z5 to z6 renders as critical in the topology graph while the playtime path ignores it

## Expected impact
The highlighted route and the priced route agree. Making the caves chain critical would change the static critical total, currently pinned at 47m 43s by playtime-what-if.test.tsx.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - critical path drawn equals critical path priced
Before: 1 critical edge with an unreachable source, walked by hand over 22 edges
After: predicted 0 with an authored flag change
Method: simulation - the data was walked; which flag is right is a design intent the round cannot read from the tree
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: A vitest invariant over STATIC_WORLD: every criticalPath edge's fromId is reachable from a hub along critical edges; red today on z5, then green under each candidate flag change, comparing the critical total on both arms
